findings.evidence: OrthogonalComplement.lean:152-166 and OrthogonalQuotient.lean:119-137 are the same proof skeleton. The PR description states the point of `quotientOfLeRadical` is that the orthogonal quotient "reuse[s] the descent machinery instead of duplicating it"; nondegeneracy is the one piece left duplicated. Note `addSubgroupOf_orthogonalComplement_le_radical` (line 60) already supplies one inclusion; the general lemma needs only the other.
findings.fix: Add `theorem isNondegenerate_quotientOfLeRadical (K) (hK : K ≤ A.radical) (h : A.radical ≤ K) : (A.quotientOfLeRadical K hK).IsNondegenerate` next to `quotientOfLeRadical` (the existing proof body works verbatim, ending with `h` instead of `le_rfl`). Then `isNondegenerate_radicalQuotient := isNondegenerate_quotientOfLeRadical A.radical le_rfl le_rfl`, and the orthogonal case becomes the reverse inclusion `IsNondegenerate → (A.restrict (A.orthogonalComplement H)).radical ≤ H.addSubgroupOf (A.orthogonalComplement H)` — the `H^⊥⊥ = H` argument, which is the only new mathematics here — fed to the general lemma.
findings.issue: `IsNondegenerate.isNondegenerate_orthogonalQuotient` duplicates the proof of `isNondegenerate_radicalQuotient` (OrthogonalComplement.lean:152-166) verbatim in shape: `isNondegenerate_of_injective`, `injective_iff_map_eq_zero`, destructure by surjectivity, `← AddMonoidHom.mem_ker` + `_ker`, then the same `calc` through `DFunLike.congr_fun`. Both are the special case of one general fact the PR does not state.

findings.evidence: `IsLagrangian H : Prop := H = A.orthogonalComplement H` (Basic.lean:631); `orthogonalQuotientMk_eq_zero_iff` (line 112) and `orthogonalQuotientMk_surjective` (line 96) are both hypothesis-free. `Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique` at mathlib/Mathlib/SetTheory/Cardinal/Finite.lean:197; `AddSubgroup.addSubgroupOf_self` at mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Map.lean:345. The present proof needs `hA` only because it routes through `IsLagrangian.card_sq` and `card_orthogonalQuotient_mul_sq`.
findings.fix: Drop `hA` and prove directly: for `x : A.orthogonalComplement H`, `hH.symm ▸ x.2 : (x : A) ∈ H`, so `orthogonalQuotientMk_eq_zero_iff` gives `A.orthogonalQuotientMk H x = 0`; with `orthogonalQuotientMk_surjective` the carrier is `Subsingleton` and nonempty, so `Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique` closes it. Equivalently `H.addSubgroupOf (A.orthogonalComplement H) = ⊤` by `AddSubgroup.addSubgroupOf_self`.
findings.issue: `IsLagrangian.card_orthogonalQuotient` assumes `hA : A.IsNondegenerate`, which the result does not require. For `H = H^⊥` the quotient is trivial for purely formal reasons.

summary: The `quotientOfLeRadical` refactor is the right generalization but stops short of the nondegeneracy lemma, which is re-proved from scratch for the orthogonal quotient. Separately, `IsLagrangian.card_orthogonalQuotient` carries an unnecessary nondegeneracy hypothesis.
